1._section_summary: This abstract describes a single study examining the factor structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among Indonesian women (n=262) and men (n=278) in Jakarta, Indonesia. Men reported significantly higher body appreciation than women, with no significant ethnic differences observed.
